description: VN→ZH aspect over-marking: Vietnamese has no aspect particle, so learners over-apply 了 as a generic past marker — including on habitual clauses where perfective 了 is ungrammatical ('我每天吃了饭'). Rule zh-habitual-le-overmark drops the post-verb 了 when a habitual adverb co-occurs with a closed action verb + 了.
fp_risk_note: Medium risk, tightly scoped. Fires only when a habitual adverb (每天/经常/常常/通常/总是) co-occurs with a closed action verb (吃喝看买做写说去来读听) + 了. A completed single event ('我昨天吃了饭') keeps 了 because 昨天 is not habitual; verbs outside the set ('我经常忘了钥匙' — 忘 not in the set) are untouched.

positive.notes: 每天 (habitual) + 吃了 → 吃 (drop perfective 了).

negative.notes: 昨天 is a bounded past occasion, not habitual — 吃了 is correct (completed event), must abstain.
Already correct — no 了 to drop, must abstain.
忘 is not in the action-verb set — '忘了' (forget) is a valid change-of-state 了 even with a habitual adverb, must abstain.
